source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
The model's complexity makes it hard to understand and review.
The dashboards fail to clearly show the main information required by decision-makers, including project returns, debt performance, and overall bankability.
There is more emphasis on the calculations than on communicating the investment story.

I believe you could add value by streamlining the model so it is simpler to understand and audit, as well as by strengthening the dashboards and project finance analysis. I want a model that functions technically while also clearly showing investors that the project is financially viable, bankable, and attractive.

value_updates.communication_objective: Clearly communicate the investment story and show that the project is financially viable, bankable, and attractive.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Sure, that’s fine; we can close the contract at this point.

For clarity and to have it on the record, I delivered the first draft on schedule, and it included everything from the original brief. After you said it was difficult to follow, I did not disregard that feedback. Instead, I submitted a second version with substantial revisions that directly addressed it. This included a simplified dashboard, assumptions with clear sources, separate cash flows for both funding scenarios, extra financial statements, and a brief summary presentation to make the review easier. I sent that second deliverable before you asked for this refund. Despite my requests, I received no specific review comments on either the first draft or the second version.

Because both milestones were completed and delivered according to scope, I will not issue a refund. I will take this through Upwork's dispute process to settle the outstanding milestone payment. You may leave whichever review you believe is accurate, and I will do likewise. The delivered work and our message history can speak for themselves.

I’m happy for both sides to conclude this professionally.

execution.observed_behavior: The freelancer reports that the second delivered version included a simplified dashboard intended to address the client's difficulty following the model.

routing_warnings.description: The complaint concerns the overall model presentation and inability to understand how figures were produced; it does not specifically identify the dashboard.
The freelancer commits to creating a separate concise presentation file rather than modifying the dashboard.
The message specifies references from the separate presentation file to the detailed working model.
